about_the_game:
Every round in Deckout plays differently. Choose the required number of cards face-down, then reveal hands in turn. Scoring happens on the spot with clear visual feedback, while a randomly chosen round rule twists the math—sometimes boosting pairs or straights, other times flipping the logic entirely. When the dust settles, the lowest performer gets hammered and loses a heart. With only three hearts, tension builds fast; the last player standing wins.

Play with friends or add smart bots that act like real players and react to what happens on the table. The whole experience is built to read at a glance so the fun never slows down.

Key features

  • 2–4 players: play with friends or fill seats with bots.

  • Secret picks, sequential reveals: a quick, dramatic rhythm every round.

  • Random round rules: fresh strategies each match, no two sessions alike.

  • Hammer & hearts: three hearts only—fall behind and you’ll feel it.

  • Snappy matches: designed for 5–10 minute bursts of competitive chaos.

  • Expressive characters and punchy audio for instant, readable feedback.

  • Achievements to track your highlights.

short_description: Deckout is a fast, competitive card game for 2–4 players. Secretly pick your cards, reveal in order, play by a random round rule, and survive the hammer—each hit costs a heart. Quick rounds, big laughs, sharp decisions.
